item.title: Onomichi Temple Walk & Cat Alley: A Hillside Town — Guide
item.description: Onomichi is a charming old port town on the Seto Inland Sea, built on a steep hillside laced with narrow lanes, stone stairways and cats, looking out over a channel busy with ships. Its signature experience is the Temple Walk, a marked trail linking some twenty-five temples along the slope, threading between old wooden houses, hidden shrines and viewpoints over the sea and islands. Along the way runs the famous Cat Alley (Neko no Hosomichi), decorated with painted cat stones and home to real strays, cafes and craft shops.
